items.title: 4 High-Yield Energy Stocks That Pay Roth IRA Investors Tax-Free Income
items.summary: A $1 million energy dividend portfolio hands the IRS a surprising bill every year, and one account type erases it completely. Four blue-chip payers, one hidden trap for partnership stocks, and a gap that snowballs over two decades.

items.title: Invest $200,000 in These 5 Dividend Stocks to Fund Your Retirement Income
